name: Myanmar Baptist Convention

facts.value: 1865, Burma Baptist Missionary Convention. Mission from 1813 under Adoniram Judson

citations.excerpt: In 1865, the Baptist churches in Burma organized themselves under the name "Burma Baptist Missionary Convention".
the first permanent Baptist Evangelists and mission came in 1813 from America, under Adoniram Judson.

facts.value: The Baptist convention of Myanmar, the country's largest Protestant body. It was renamed Burma Baptist Convention in 1954.

citations.excerpt: The Baptists are the largest protestant denomination in the country.
In 1954, the name was changed to Burma Baptist Convention.

research_notes: Parent set to g105 (American Baptist mission, Triennial Convention formed to support Judson) instead of generic Baptists.
